neon-glass-blue.name: Neon Glass Blue
neon-glass-blue.description: Deep navy glass, electric blue edges, and a soft cyan glow.

futuristic-electric-blue.name: Futuristic Electric Blue
futuristic-electric-blue.description: Sharper panels, stronger electric blue, and a heavier neon rim.

cyan-holographic.name: Cyan Holographic
cyan-holographic.description: Translucent cyan glass with a holographic highlight and cooler text.

dark-glass-professional.name: Dark Glass Professional
dark-glass-professional.description: Denser glass, quieter borders, and a restrained blue accent.

minimal-dark-blue.name: Minimal Dark Blue
minimal-dark-blue.description: Nearly solid surfaces, no glow, and compact professional geometry.

aurora-glass.name: Aurora Glass
aurora-glass.description: Deep ink-green glass, teal edges, and a soft aurora glow.

cyberpunk-violet.name: Cyberpunk Violet
cyberpunk-violet.description: Violet neon glass with magenta highlights and a cyan accent.

arctic-frost.name: Arctic Frost
arctic-frost.description: Ice-white glass, blue edges, and a soft blue shadow.

obsidian-mono.name: Obsidian Mono
obsidian-mono.description: Black glass, white highlights, and almost no glow.

emerald-matrix.name: Emerald Matrix
emerald-matrix.description: Deep green glass with emerald edges and a quiet terminal glow.

amber-industrial.name: Amber Industrial
amber-industrial.description: Charcoal glass, amber edges, and a steady console glow.

nordic-light.name: Nordic Light
nordic-light.description: Soft gray-white glass, blue emphasis, and a teal accent.

pure-white.name: Pure White
pure-white.description: Quiet white surfaces, a fine gray edge, and a blue accent.

soft-gray.name: Soft Gray
soft-gray.description: Neutral gray workspace, white panels, and a teal accent.

warm-sand.name: Warm Sand
warm-sand.description: Warm cream surfaces, brown emphasis, and a muted olive accent.

mist-blue.name: Mist Blue
mist-blue.description: Cool blue-gray canvas, white panels, and a restrained blue accent.

sage-calm.name: Sage Calm
sage-calm.description: Soft green-gray canvas, white panels, and a calm olive accent.
